title: AgentHarness
description: The context an AI agent receives from OpenMetadata: which knowledge goes in, at which hook events, with which instructions, skills, guardrails and memory settings. The entity holds the published harness. Edits are held in a draft outside the entity until they are published, so each version is one publish or one enable or disable switch.

harnessKind.description: Default is the one company-wide harness that applies to every user. Persona is a harness for the members of one persona that extends the default.

hookEvent.description: Agent host event at which context is delivered.

guardrailLevel.description: What a guardrail does when it matches, from least to most strict. Off does nothing, Warn adds a warning to the context, Block denies the tool call.

eventDelivery.description: Delivery setting of one hook event.

enabled.description: Whether context is delivered at this event. On a persona harness, true adds the event for the persona. An event the default delivers stays delivered whatever the persona sets.

tokenBudget.description: Most tokens delivered at this event. On a persona harness it cannot exceed the default's budget for the event.

skillSetting.description: Whether one server-registered skill is offered to agents.

name.description: Name of a skill listed by `GET /v1/agentHarness/skills`.

enabled.description: Whether the skill is offered. On a persona harness, true adds the skill for the persona. A skill the default offers stays offered whatever the persona sets.

id.description: Id of a guardrail listed by `GET /v1/agentHarness/guardrails`.

level.description: Level the guardrail runs at. On a persona harness it cannot be less strict than the default's level.

toolAccessDefault.description: What happens to a call to an MCP server that no entry lists.

toolAccessLevel.description: What happens to a call an entry matches, from least to most strict. Allow lets it run, Warn lets it run with a warning in the context, Block denies it.

toolAccessServer.description: Access to one MCP server, or to some of its tools.

match.description: MCP server name as the agent host reports it, the `<server>` in a tool name `mcp__<server>__<tool>`. Matched without regard to case.

level.description: What happens to a matching call.

tools.description: Tool names the entry applies to. Absent or empty means every tool of the server.

toolAccess.description: Which MCP servers and tools an agent may call. The first entry that matches a call decides; a call no entry matches gets `default`. A persona harness can only make the default's decisions stricter: each call gets the stricter of the default's decision and the persona's.

default.description: Decision for calls no entry matches.

servers.description: Entries in the order they are matched.

memoryReview.description: Who approves a memory an agent captured. StewardReview follows the deployment's memory lifecycle. AuthorOnly keeps the memory private to its author.

memoryVisibility.description: Who receives a memory an agent captured: only its author, the members of the author's persona, or everyone.

answerHarness.description: How `finish_answer` writes the "How I got this" block. Only the default harness's settings apply, because two fiscal calendars would give two answers to one question. Unset groups take built-in defaults.

calendar.description: The organization's calendar for time phrases such as last quarter.

fiscalYearStart.description: Month and day the fiscal year starts, as MM-DD.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone that decides where a day starts and ends.

trust.description: Which trust signals the block reports.

failingTests.description: Whether failing data quality tests on a cited table appear in the block.

openIncidents.description: Whether open incidents on a cited table appear in the block.

staleAfter.description: Age after which a table's freshness is flagged, as a number of hours (h) or days (d), for example 24h.

showSql.description: Whether the block includes the SQL. A query that was not run always shows it.

memorySettings.description: How memories that agents capture are stored. A persona harness that sets these replaces the default's settings for its members.

capture.description: Whether agents may propose memories during a session.

linkAssets.description: Whether a captured memory is linked to the assets used in the turn.

dedup.description: Whether a captured memory is merged with an existing near-duplicate.

visibility.description: Who receives a captured memory. Must be Private when review is AuthorOnly.

name.description: Name of the harness. `CompanyDefault` for the default harness and the persona's id for a persona harness, so a persona rename or a persona named like the default cannot collide.

fullyQualifiedName.description: Fully qualified name, the same as `name`.

kind.description: Whether this is the company default or a persona harness.

persona.description: Persona whose members this harness serves. Required on a persona harness and absent on the default. At most one harness refers to a persona.

enabled.description: Whether the harness is applied. A disabled persona harness leaves its members with the default alone. A disabled default delivers nothing to anyone. Changed with `PUT /v1/agentHarness/{id}/enabled`, never through a draft.

publishedAt.description: Time of the latest publish in Unix epoch time milliseconds. Absent on a persona harness that has never been published, which is not applied.

context.description: Knowledge rules, persona prompt, character budget and cache lifetime. The definition's own `enabled` flag must stay true, because the harness's `enabled` decides. Its read-only cache fields are not stored.

companyInstructions.description: Instructions every agent receives. Only on the default harness.

perTurnTokenBudget.description: Most tokens delivered across the events of one turn. At least the sum of the enabled events' budgets.

events.description: Delivery settings per hook event. The default lists every event. A persona harness lists only the events it adds or whose budget it lowers.

skills.description: Skills offered to agents. A persona harness lists only the skills it adds.

guardrails.description: Guardrail levels. A persona harness lists only the guardrails it makes stricter.

toolAccess.description: Which MCP servers and tools agents may call. Absent means every call is allowed.

memory.description: Agent memory settings. Absent on a persona harness that uses the default's.

answerHarness.description: How `finish_answer` writes its citation block. Read from the default harness only.

updatedAt.description: Last update time in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

impersonatedBy.description: Bot user that performed the action on behalf of the actual user.

changeDescription.description: Change that led to this version.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Incremental change that led to this version.

deleted.description: When true indicates the entity has been soft deleted.
